title: 140 drug war-related cases seen for disposition by end of 2026 – CHR
summary: The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) aims to have 140 drug war-related cases for disposition by the end of the year, according to the CHR's budget sponsor, Representative Ma. Cristina Talavera-Lopez.
